# Vendored libraries

`maplibre-gl.js` and `maplibre-gl.css` are copied unchanged from
DutchMeshCore-Observers (`web/js/vendor/`, `web/css/vendor/`) on 2026-09-30, so
the mockups use the same MapLibre build as production. Version and licence: see
`web/js/vendor/README.md` in that repo (the "deck.gl.js, maplibre-gl.js" section).
Leaflet is not allowed anywhere in this repo.

The clippyjs agents (the win95 buddy) were removed with the win95 style on 2026-10-08.
